decisions.reason: The Example does not identify its length-coordinate frame as orthonormal. The supplier explicitly says length coordinates need not be orthonormal. In coordinates x^1=2y^1 on standard Minkowski space with x^0=y^0, g_11=1/4, so the prescribed F_01=-E0/c gives E_U^1=4E0, not E0, and q=chi E_U fails. Specifying g_ab=diag(-1,1,1,1) repairs this missing hypothesis and licenses every contraction and component divergence.
